items.title_cn: 基于mPASS与影像特征的机器学习模型用于急性胰腺炎临床相关结局的早期评估
items.title_en: A machine learning model based on mPASS and imaging features for early assessment of clinically relevant outcomes in acute pancreatitis
items.journal: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
items.summary_cn: 该研究基于mPASS评分和影像特征构建机器学习模型，用于急性胰腺炎临床相关结局的早期评估，与用户关注的急性胰腺炎诊治方向高度相关，但摘要未提供具体结果细节。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎最初72小时：早期临床决策中的变异模式
items.title_en: The first 72 hours of acute pancreatitis: patterns of variability in early clinical decision-making
items.abstract_cn: 为评估急性胰腺炎（AP）早期管理中遵循循证国际指南的真实世界依从性，并识别在首72小时诊疗过程中临床决策变异性的分布情况，本研究开展了一项多中心横断面调查，对象为西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区活跃执业的全科外科、消化内科和急诊医学的顾问医师及受训医师。采用经专家审核的21项问卷，评估受访者在AP早期管理八个关键领域中相对于国际共识建议（IAP/APA和WSES）的自我报告实践情况。采用卡方检验和多变量逻辑回归分析影响指南依从性的相关因素。共有165名临床医师完成了调查。自我报告的关键建议依从性较低，尤其是在目标导向液体复苏和早期经口进食方面，而超过一半的受访者报告在无确诊感染的情况下使用抗生素。关键在于，临床实践变异性并非均匀分布。最大差异出现在时间敏感的治疗相关决策中，尤其是液体复苏和营养策略，其依从性因临床医师经验和医院规模而显著不同。相比之下，抗生素使用在各亚组间无显著差异，表明存在一致且广泛的偏离指南建议的现象。多变量分析显示，总体依从性与临床医师经验（p = 0.035）和医院规模（p = 0.009）独立相关，但与医学专科或临床医师年龄无关。AP早期管理在各临床领域的自我报告实践存在显著差异。变异性在时间敏感的治疗决策中最大，而抗生素过度使用则表现为各亚组中普遍存在的不一致实践模式。结构化的本地路径和决策支持工具可能有助于缩小这些实施差距。
items.abstract_en: To assess real-world adherence to evidence-based international guidelines in the early management of acute pancreatitis (AP), and to identify how variability in clinical decision-making is distributed during the first 72 h of care. This multicentre, cross-sectional survey was conducted among consultant physicians and trainees in General Surgery, Gastroenterology, and Emergency Medicine actively practising in Catalonia, Spain. An expert-reviewed 21-item questionnaire assessed self-reported practices across eight key domains of early AP management relative to international consensus recommendations (IAP/APA and WSES). Factors associated with guideline adherence were analysed using chi-square tests and multivariable logistic regression. A total of 165 clinicians clinicians completed the survey. Self-reported adherence to key recommendations was low, particularly for target-directed fluid resuscitation and early oral feeding, while more than half of respondents reported antibiotic use in the absence of confirmed infection. Crucially, clinical practice variability was not uniformly distributed. The greatest differences were observed in time-sensitive, treatment-related decisions, particularly fluid resuscitation and nutritional strategies, where adherence varied significantly according to clinician experience and hospital size. In contrast, antibiotic use showed no significant variation across subgroups, indicating a consistent and widespread deviation from guideline recommendations. On multivariable analysis, overall adherence was independently associated with clinician experience ( p = 0.035) and hospital size ( p = 0.009), but not with medical speciality or clinician age. Early AP management showed substantial variation in self-reported practice across clinical domains. Variability was greatest for time-sensitive therapeutic decisions, whereas antibiotic overuse appeared to represent a widespread pattern of non-concordant practice across subgroups. Structured local pathways and decision-support tools may help reduce these implementation gaps.
items.summary_cn: 该多中心横断面调查显示，急性胰腺炎早期管理的临床实践与指南推荐存在显著差异，尤其在液体复苏和早期经口进食等时间敏感决策上依从性低，且抗生素过度使用普遍；临床经验与医院规模与总体依从性独立相关。

items.title_cn: 多模式血液吸附治疗重症急性胰腺炎的疗效：一项前瞻性初步研究
items.title_en: Efficacy of multimodal hemosorption in severe acute pancreatitis: a prospective pilot study
items.abstract_cn: 引言：重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）的死亡率仍然很高。早期多器官功能衰竭（MOF）是决定疾病严重程度和预后的主要因素。治疗主要为对症支持，体外疗法的角色仍存在争议。尽管已有研究探讨了早期SAP中细胞因子吸附和血液透析滤过的作用，但脂多糖（LPS）吸附的纳入仍了解甚少。目的：评估多模式细胞因子和LPS血液灌流对伴多器官功能衰竭的早期急性胰腺炎临床和实验室指标的影响。材料与方法：研究纳入30例重症急性胰腺炎患者。主要前瞻性干预组包括15例接受标准治疗联合多模式血液吸附的患者。前瞻性对照组包括15例平行选择的接受标准治疗的患者。比较两组间的临床、实验室和结局指标。结果：将多模式血液灌流纳入SAP早期多器官功能衰竭的管理中，有助于研究组器官功能障碍的更快缓解（RMANOVA；p = 0.009）。至第3天，乳酸浓度从2.0（1.3；3.0）显著降至1.5（1.2；2.1）mmol/L（p = 0.026），C反应蛋白从302（258；405）降至220（163；281）mg/L（p = 0.026）。在血液灌流组，ICU住院时间较短——13.5（9.6；16.1）天，而对照组为18.9（11；55.8）天（p = 0.059），总住院时间缩短至19（17；36）天，而对照组为25（14；56）天（p = 0.689）。结论：在我们的SAP患者中使用多模式血液灌流与器官功能障碍的更快消退和炎症标志物降低相关，但该研究缺乏足够的效能来推荐其常规临床应用。为证实多模式血液吸附在急性胰腺炎早期阶段有效性的假设，需要更大规模的前瞻性研究。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Mortality in severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) remains high. Early multiple organ failure (MOF) is the primary factor determining disease severity and outcomes. Treatment is largely symptomatic, and the role of extracorporeal therapies remains controversial. While studies have examined cytokine adsorption and hemodiafiltration in early SAP, the inclusion of lipopolysaccharide (LPS) adsorption remains poorly understood. OBJECTIVE: To assess the impact of multimodal cytokine and LPS hemoperfusion on clinical and laboratory parameters in early-phase acute pancreatitis with MOF. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The study included 30 patients with severe acute pancreatitis. The main prospective intervention group consisted of 15 patients receiving standard therapy in combination with multimodal hemosorption. The prospective control group consisted of 15 parallel-selected patients receiving standard therapy. Clinical, laboratory, and outcome measures were compared between groups. RESULTS: Incorporation of multimodal hemoperfusion into the management of early multiple organ failure in SAP contributed to faster resolution of organ dysfunction in the study group (RMANOVA; p = 0.009). By day 3, it significantly reduced lactate concentration from 2.0 (1.3; 3.0) to 1.5 (1.2; 2.1) mmol/L (p = 0.026) and C-reactive protein from 302 (258; 405) to 220 (163; 281) mg/L (p = 0.026). In the hemoperfusion group, ICU length of stay was shorter — 13,5 (9,6; 16,1) days versus 18,9 (11; 55,8) days in the control group (p = 0.059), and total hospital stay decreased to 19 (17; 36) days compared with 25 (14; 56) days in the control group (p = 0.689). CONCLUSIONS: The use of multimodal hemoperfusion in our SAP patients was linked to faster regression of organ dysfunction and reduced inflammatory markers, yet the study lacks sufficient power to recommend its routine clinical application. To confirm the hypothesis regarding the effectiveness of multimodal hemosorption in the early phase of PTP, a larger prospective study is required.
items.summary_cn: Multimodal hemoperfusion in severe acute pancreatitis with early organ failure was associated with faster resolution of organ dysfunction and reduced inflammatory markers (lactate, CRP) by day 3, though ICU and hospital stay differences were not statistically significant.

items.title_cn: 酒精性急性胰腺炎中的淀粉酶和脂肪酶：是时候重新思考诊断阈值了吗？
items.title_en: Amylase and Lipase in Alcohol-Induced Acute Pancreatitis: Time to Rethink Diagnostic Thresholds?
items.summary_cn: 该论文探讨酒精性急性胰腺炎中淀粉酶和脂肪酶的诊断阈值是否需要重新考量，但摘要未提供具体研究发现或结论。

items.title_cn: 腹腔镜胰体尾切除术后感染性腹膜后脂肪坏死的视频辅助腹膜后清创术
items.title_en: Video-assisted retroperitoneal debridement for infected retroperitoneal fat necrosis following laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy
items.abstract_cn: 视频辅助腹膜后清创术（VARD）是一种成熟且微创的治疗感染性坏死性胰腺炎的方法。然而，其在胰腺切除术后患者中的应用鲜有报道。我们报告一例腹腔镜远端胰腺切除术后发生广泛感染性腹膜后脂肪坏死，采用包含VARD的阶梯式治疗策略成功处理的病例。一名81岁女性因胰尾胰腺导管腺癌接受了腹腔镜远端胰腺切除术。术后第7天，患者突发腹痛。计算机断层扫描（CT）显示残余胰腺增大，胰周脂肪间隙模糊加重。术后第9天和第12天的随访CT显示胰残端周围积液进行性增大，炎症改变迅速向腹膜后间隙扩展。采用禁食和抗生素治疗的保守管理使炎症标志物暂时改善。然而，术后第38天出现了广泛的感染性腹膜后脂肪坏死。术后第43天，CT引导下经皮导管引流因坏死组织高度黏稠未能实现充分的感染源控制，需行手术坏死组织清除术。另置入一根引流管以建立腹膜后入路，随后于术后第55天行VARD，清除坏死脂肪组织61克。炎症标志物迅速改善，患者于术后第102天情况良好出院。腹腔镜远端胰腺切除术后的感染性腹膜后脂肪坏死通过包含VARD的阶梯式策略成功处理。本病例凸显了VARD作为术后感染性腹膜后脂肪坏死的一种微创治疗选择的价值。
items.abstract_en: Video-assisted retroperitoneal debridement (VARD) is an established and minimally invasive treatment option for infected necrotizing pancreatitis. However, its application in the postoperative setting after pancreatic resection has rarely been described. We report a case of extensive infected retroperitoneal fat necrosis following laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy that was successfully managed using a step-up approach incorporating VARD. An 81-year-old woman underwent laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreatic tail. On postoperative day (POD) 7, she developed sudden-onset abdominal pain. Computed tomography (CT) demonstrated enlargement of the remnant pancreas with increased peripancreatic fat stranding. Follow-up CT on POD 9 and 12 revealed progressive enlargement of the fluid collection around the pancreatic stump with rapid extension of inflammatory changes into the retroperitoneal space. Conservative management with fasting and antibiotic therapy resulted in temporary improvement in inflammatory markers. However, extensive infected retroperitoneal fat necrosis developed on POD 38. On POD 43, CT-guided percutaneous catheter drainage failed to achieve adequate source control due to highly viscous necrotic debris, necessitating surgical necrosectomy. An additional drainage tube was placed to establish a retroperitoneal access route, after which VARD was performed on POD 55, with removal of 61 g of necrotic fatty tissue. Inflammatory markers rapidly improved, and the patient was discharged in good condition on POD 102. Infected retroperitoneal fat necrosis after laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy was successfully managed using a step-up strategy incorporating VARD. This case highlights VARD as a minimally invasive therapeutic option for postoperative infected retroperitoneal fat necrosis.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告展示了视频辅助腹膜后清创术（VARD）作为阶梯式治疗方案的一部分，成功处理了腹腔镜远端胰腺切除术后发生的广泛感染性腹膜后脂肪坏死，且该技术此前在胰腺切除术后并发症中的应用鲜有报道。

items.title_cn: 胰腺膨隆：揭示自身免疫之外的原因——基于影像学的弥漫性胰腺增大诊断方法
items.title_en: The bulging pancreas: unmasking causes beyond autoimmunity—an imaging-based approach to diffuse pancreatic enlargement
items.abstract_cn: 弥漫性胰腺肿大常被归因于自身免疫性胰腺炎（AIP），但多种良性、遗传性、炎症性（包括急性间质性水肿性胰腺炎）及恶性病变均可产生相似的影像学表现。本综述提供了一种基于影像学的诊断思路，用于识别弥漫性胰腺肿大、应用实用的测量规则，并将AIP与关键类似疾病进行鉴别。本文强调了AIP的典型影像学特征（弥漫性“腊肠样”形态、包膜样边缘、长段胰管狭窄而无明显上游扩张）以及临床/血清学相关性及类固醇治疗反应的价值。所综述的关键类似疾病包括急性间质性水肿性胰腺炎、胰腺脂肪沉积症、von Hippel-Lindau（VHL）病、Mahvash综合征、浸润性腺癌、淋巴瘤、转移瘤及弥漫性神经内分泌肿瘤，每种疾病均具有鉴别意义的影像学和临床线索。在合理排除胰腺恶性肿瘤后，结合客观测量、胰管评估、强化模式、全身表现及治疗反应的结构化评估方法，可减少弥漫性胰腺肿大的误诊，并在必要时加快适当的活检或肿瘤学检查流程。
items.abstract_en: Diffuse pancreatic enlargement is frequently attributed to autoimmune pancreatitis (AIP), but several benign, genetic, inflammatory, including acute interstitial edematous pancreatitis, and malignant entities can produce a similar imaging appearance. This review provides an imaging-based approach to recognize diffuse pancreatic enlargement, apply pragmatic measurement rules, and differentiate AIP from key mimics. Classic AIP imaging features (diffuse "sausage-like" morphology, capsule-like rim, long-segment duct narrowing without marked upstream dilation) and the value of clinical/serologic correlation and steroid response are emphasized. Key mimics reviewed include acute interstitial edematous pancreatitis, pancreatic lipomatosis, von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) disease, Mahvash syndrome, infiltrative adenocarcinoma, lymphoma, metastases, and diffuse neuroendocrine tumor, each with discriminating imaging and clinical clues. A structured assessment combining objective measurement, duct evaluation, enhancement pattern, systemic findings, and response to therapy after pancreatic malignancy has been reasonably excluded can reduce misdiagnosis of diffuse pancreatic enlargement and expedite appropriate biopsy or oncologic workup when indicated.
items.summary_cn: 该综述提出基于影像学方法鉴别弥漫性胰腺肿大的多种病因，强调自身免疫性胰腺炎（AIP）的典型影像特征及其与急性间质水肿性胰腺炎等类似疾病的鉴别要点，并建议在排除胰腺恶性肿瘤后结合客观测量、导管评估、增强模式及治疗反应进行结构化评估以减少误诊。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
